why: Both moved the same four chat sites cleanly, but B found the more serious behaviour break — the bot stored a function result with no assistant function_call turn, which Router 400s and which poisons the chat's history for every later turn — and fixed it in application code rather than hand-editing the vendored runtime as A did, with 9 live __handle_function_call requests and an eleven-path side-by-side to prove it. B's system judgment is also better measured and better aimed: gpt-5.1 shown live to be cheaper than gpt-4o on input, 10x cheaper on cached input and terser (where A's only model proposal is a quality downgrade to gpt-4.1-mini, unbuilt), prefix caching measured at -47% on exactly this resend-the-whole-history workload that A dismissed on weak reasoning, and two plausible ideas killed with data (gpt-4o-mini bills 8,522 input tokens for a 277-token image; usage.cost is absent on the streaming paths that are this bot's default — which quietly undermines A's i6).
A_best: i4: identifying that the hardcoded 2024-era model tables crash the bot on any other model id, and finding the real encode_image bug (every data URL labelled image/jpeg while Telegram photos are PNG, a hard 400 on Anthropic) — a genuine unlock A proved live by running the whole bot on claude-haiku-4-5.
B_best: m2: catching that the plugin history shape was only ever valid because OpenAI tolerated it, proving the 400 live, fixing it the way OpenAI itself documents, and quantifying the cost (58→87 prompt tokens, one extra history slot).
A_worst: Claims the streamed plugin tool loop was exercised end to end against real Router, but the outside check's live data shows no __handle_function_call requests at all — so the one call site that would have 400d on Router appears unverified, and the fix for it sits in a hand-edited vendored runtime the check flagged.
B_worst: The improvements are unranked and two of the strongest (i4, i5) both silently change which model answers users, so the voice shifts with nothing in the reply saying so; i1's headline -47% is also confounded by OpenAI's automatic prefix caching, which B concedes was already hitting without the key.
